common.title: Kinetria AI — CRM for employee ideas and concerns
common.description: Employee feedback from first message to resolution.

landing.label: CRM for employee ideas and concerns
landing.lead: Employees share ideas and report issues in chat. Managers see requests, owners, and next steps on one board.
landing.employeeText: Share an idea or report an issue and see the reply in your workspace.
landing.managerText: See which requests need an owner and follow them through to resolution.
landing.step1Text: They describe an idea or issue in their own words.
landing.step2Text: It suggests a title, description, and category. The employee reviews and submits the request.
landing.step3Text: The owner works on the request and records a decision. The author sees its status and outcome.
landing.exampleTitle: How a designer gets an answer
landing.exampleText: An item has two identifiers in a specification. The catalog owner confirms which one to use and records the answer on the employee's request.
landing.caseMessage: Which item should we use in the specification?
landing.caseResolution: Use the current entry in the catalog.
landing.pricingTitle: What does it cost to get started?
landing.pricingText: Pricing depends on the number of departments, integrations, and hosting requirements. We agree on the scope before launch.
landing.pilot3: Measure response times and the share of requests with an outcome
landing.q1: What happens if a request has no owner?
landing.a1: It goes to the fallback queue. A manager can assign an owner and see the assignment in the history.
landing.a2: Authors see their own requests and published outcomes. Owners see assigned requests, and managers see their queues.
landing.a3: Choose a demo role to explore the workspace, chat preview, or CRM board with sample data.
landing.estimateText: Tell us how many departments you want to include and what you want to measure. We’ll use that to prepare your request.
